summary: Dell Technologies Inc. entered a new $6 billion senior unsecured revolving credit facility on June 10, 2026, replacing a prior 2021 credit agreement. The facility, maturing June 10, 2031, includes a $500 million letter of credit sub-facility and allows incremental commitments. Borrowings bear interest at SOFR or base rate plus a margin based on Dell's credit ratings. The filing is a routine financing arrangement for general corporate purposes, not a special situation. There are no acquisition, divestiture, or activist elements; the event is purely a refinancing of existing debt.
